title: Entity cases
responsibility: Shows recorded case inputs beside observed outputs or errors.

inputs.name: EntityCases.document
inputs.description: Required parsed recorded result passed to the case extractor. Caller is responsible for reading and checking its bytes before supplying it.

inputs.name: EntityCases.unit
inputs.description: Optional unit identifier limiting direct invocation rows to that function.

inputs.name: EntityCases.callable
inputs.description: Optional flag, true by default. Controls wording distinguishing observed end-to-end behavior from a direct function call; false is suitable for noncallable entities.

outputs.name: EntityCases
outputs.description: Gap explanation when cases cannot be extracted, otherwise a Case/Input/Observed output table using recorded values. Failed cases show the recorded error. Full recorded JSON is serialized only when its disclosure opens; does not invent missing outputs.
